convention: literal line-by-line, as in the Horace batch briefs (rules 1-7)
reasoning_summary: Written inline by the coordinator session. Hyperbata left split with notes naming the agreeing word (3.14 Hispana/ora, decorae/matres, atras/curas; 3.16 paucorum/iugerum; 3.18 larga/vina; 3.23 quae/victima). Negatives kept in place (3.14.27 non ego hoc ferrem; 3.15.7 non si quid; 3.16.33-38 nec ... nec; 3.23.5-6). Metaphors literal with notes (verticem 'head', cornua 'horns', marino rore 'sea-dew', saliente mica). Supplied possessives noted (her, your, his, its). Names as in the Latin (Lyaeus, Africus, Algidus). 3.16.32 fallit sorte beatior kept literal with the sense in the note.
